# Foundations of Energy Storage Safety

Turn any physical room into a fully equipped, high-voltage lab with **Foundations of Energy Storage Safety**, an immersive Mixed Reality (MR) training experience.

Master electrical fundamentals and top-tier Energy Storage Solutions with hands-on practice. Learn critical safety protocols and troubleshooting techniques without the physical dangers of live voltage.
